scripts.apk:local: expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.verify:env: expo export --clear --platform android --output-dir .envcheck >/dev/null 2>&1 && B=$(ls .envcheck/_expo/static/js/android/*.hbc) && if strings $B | grep -qE '10\.0\.2\.2|your-publishable-key'; then echo 'FATAL: env lokal/placeholder masih tertanam'; rm -rf .envcheck; exit 1; elif ! strings $B | grep -q 'supabase\.co'; then echo 'FATAL: tidak ada URL Supabase, app akan mode demo'; rm -rf .envcheck; exit 1; else echo 'env OK: URL cloud tertanam'; rm -rf .envcheck; fi
